card.name: Linking word before JAK or S1P drug names
card.fires_on: The small word right before a JAK inhibitor or S1P modulator drug name, such as 'with', 'receiving' or 'other' after 'patients treated' or 'reported in patients'. It appears in adverse-event warning text.

modes.label: Patients treated with / receiving
modes.description: The word 'with' or 'receiving' after 'patients treated' or 'in patients', just before a named drug or drug class.
modes.example: Malignancies were reported in patients treated<< with>> OPZELURA.

modes.label: Other after a drug name
modes.description: The word 'other' following a named drug and 'and' or 'or', just before a class name such as JAK inhibitors or immunosuppressants.
